objective: Upgrade SourceHunter for evidence quality and make immutable capture replay the shared design, regression, and admission basis rather than a separate fallback-only task.

restricted_exact_manifest.contents: content-addressed references to immutable R1 request, response, failure and parser objects

work_packages.name: capture_replay_corpus_and_R1_decision_baseline
implementation: inventory every R1 request and its terminal response, failure or missing pair
assign each observed locator a source family, evidence-slot fit, currentness and fetch decision
create restricted exact manifest plus portable sanitized fixtures
work_packages.replay_proof: Every R1 network request has one explainable terminal classification without loading hidden Gold into the planner.

work_packages.name: evidence_objective_and_slot_planner
implementation: compile each research question into issuer results, regulatory reconciliation, customer demand, supply or counterevidence, and market context slots
bind entity role, source family, as-of window, required or optional status and stop condition
revise a query by missing slot and route rather than repeating keywords
work_packages.replay_proof: R1 navigation requests are not justified by any slot, while legitimate issuer, regulatory and ecosystem documents retain an explicit search reason.

work_packages.name: provider_neutral_multi_channel_discovery
implementation: add structured official routes for SEC submissions, forms and exhibits
add issuer IR results, news, event, sitemap, RSS and structured endpoint discovery
define a versioned external or site-search provider interface for customer, supplier, government and industry discovery
return route_unavailable when an operational provider or credential is absent
work_packages.replay_proof: Captured R1 routes are reproduced through a declared provider capability and source policy, not hard-coded benchmark URLs.

work_packages.name: pre_fetch_locator_qualification_and_currentness
implementation: score source family, path, title, entity, form, publication date, as-of fit and evidence-slot fit before fetch
reject navigation, store, privacy, generic product, footer and duplicate canonical links before network use
prefer the newest eligible filing or result while preserving older material only when a historical slot requires it
work_packages.replay_proof: Known Outlook, Store, Surface and policy noise produces zero fetch decisions; stale Dell filings cannot outrank a newer eligible filing.

work_packages.name: post_fetch_content_qualification_and_evidence_promotion
implementation: classify parsed entity, period, topic, source type, authority, evidence role and factual versus promotional content
deduplicate canonical and substantively duplicate documents
separate candidate, accepted, context_only, rejected and typed_gap without granting exact numeric authority to web text
work_packages.replay_proof: A successfully fetched page is not counted as useful unless its parsed content closes or informs a declared evidence slot.

work_packages.name: typed_transport_and_partial_terminalization
implementation: capture RemoteDisconnected, connection reset and connection abort as typed transport failures
atomically preserve partial attempts, candidates, rejections, receipts, gaps and real call counts after every step
terminate unknown project failures without discarding prior formal state
work_packages.replay_proof: The R1 request-only terminal shape becomes a typed failure and all preceding work remains materialized.

work_packages.name: integrated_replay_fake_mutation_and_efficiency_proof
implementation: run exact capture replay, DELL MU NVDA full-fake and transport, stale-date, noise, duplication, contamination and partial-result mutations
measure qualified-document yield and evidence-slot closure per network call
prove the proposed replacement budget before any fresh network authority decision
work_packages.replay_proof: Quality, reliability and efficiency gates pass together; a transport-only pass is insufficient.

work_packages.name: replacement_authority_decision
implementation: review clean-commit proof and remaining blockers
if admitted, issue at most one fresh DELL R2 exact-live admission
score target-in-pool and operational quality before admitting ranking or other cases
work_packages.replay_proof: This planning contract itself authorizes no network, model, replacement, ranking or downstream research run.

proposed_DELL_R2_budget.note: The call ceiling is a pre-registered quality and efficiency target; external latency is recorded independently and does not excuse missing terminal captures.

stop_rules: If no operational external or site-search provider exists, declare that route unavailable and do not claim broad Web search capability.
If replay cannot remove navigation and stale selections without hidden Gold, redesign the provider-neutral source-family classifier before live execution.
If replay passes but DELL R2 target-in-pool fails, remain in S1-08 candidate coverage and do not tune ranking or start S3.
Only after one DELL replacement passes may MU and NVDA transfer authority be decided separately.
NDCG, MRR, BGE and Milvus remain blocked until live target-in-pool and required-slot recall pass.
